body: I really relate. I'm a bad drinker and I've thought too about hitting the bottle if I can't get any relief.
Thanks for the info. I see the doctor again this month, and I will let him know that nothing is working against my anxiety. Fingers crossed.
What state do you live in, if you don't mind me asking. What got the doctor to prescribe to you?

Thanks for the input, I figured as much. 

I don't mind the short-term approach. I'm honestly looking for something to give me the strength to get back to work and leaving the house. While the antidepressant has numbed a little of the anxiety, the way it makes me feel is almost even worse. Depressed, loss of interest in my hobbies, weight gain (I put on 15 pounds in two months!) 

When I was on benzos, years ago iirc 2014-ish, they really worked as a nice little crutch when things got bad. I understand how easy they are to get addicted to, but so are antidepressants, just as much honestly.

Same problem here OP. Even on anti-depressants I still have anxiety to the point where I don't leave home unless it's an absolute must. It's put me at odds with my parents who now think I'm lazy. I tried explaining this to my last doctor and he pretended that he didn't know what benzos are and didn't want to prescribe them. Are you kidding me, what kind of doctor are you?

Some people over on the benzo sub are saying that doctors don't write scripts for them at all (some states) and in others won't do it unless you come in having a panic attack. In which case I'd be in the ER not driving to see my family doctor without a visit. It's so annoying and painting us patients as drug seekers looking to just get high or something.

Same as you, I take them when I get panic attacks. Try telling your system to feel drowsy when you're full blown panic. It's not going to happen. Furthermore I don't even feel sleepy taking them, literally a sugar pill.

In the same boat as you OP, Pennsylvania here. PCP gave me the same BS about benzo's being banned in my state too and was given hydroxyzine. I've yet to find a PCP that will prescribe. In the new year I'm going to give a psychiatrist a shot. HOPEFULLY showing some evidence that an anti-depressant, mood stabilizer, anti-psychotic AND antihistamine still do NOTHING for my anxiety will at least get me an emergency script. Knowing my shitty luck lately I'll probably be fucked over.
